Going to (1,2,6) would wall in number 21, the last number; going to (2,1,6) would cut off a group of 2 cells. So the line goes to (4,2,7).

Going to (4,1,6) would leave both cell (2,1,6) and number 20 needing the line next, and it can't do both; going to (6,2,7) would leave both number 20 and cell (6,4,7) needing the line next, and it can't do both. So the line goes to (4,4,7).
